root_scope: Two new source-trained fixed-feature readouts, changing fill128 to source-calibrated global gray227; only old development10 evaluation, no new final25 inference. Not an original research contribution or independent confirmation.
screen_absolute_gap: abs(matchedY-matchedX)<=0.5*(oldY-oldX) AND matchedY<oldY, with oldY-oldX>0 pre-observed
interpretation_guard: Report DeltaX and DeltaY; smaller gap can partly arise because X worsens. Do not claim at least half of Y damage explained unless DeltaY itself warrants it.
resource_limit: oneCPUthread,2160 images encoded,2 readouts,180seconds encoder hard cap; no retuning after outcome
